receiver: Uniform lab E at x=(0,0,0) and x=(0,0,1): identical mode function by declaration, not propagating/nonforward scattering

addition.response_normalization: Unit-norm fresh charged B packet; canonical q,Pi with hbar=1, I=2; no LSZ/free photon frequency normalization. Reverse order is elementwise conjugate C*, not silently omitted; retarded -i(C-C*)=2ImC. Current-source response also has instantaneous full K contact.
addition.field_path_off_meaning: Actual control H=H40+Pi^2/(2I): D removed from complete electric square, same fresh input/kick, not deleting measured electric or current observable.
addition.field_kick_projection: Exact unbounded coherent kick on field vacuum, then numerical P and unit normalization; no claim exp(i epsilon PqP) equals P exp(i epsilon q)P.
